content: It's been a little over three years since Riverdale, the CW's loose adaptation of the Archie Comics characters, aired its final episode. Now Disney is gearing up to bring audiences back to the town of Riverdale, but it will be in a wildly different way. As announced this July, Disney Plus is set to release an adaptation of the horror comic Afterlife with Archie next year. Now we know who will play Archie, Betty, Veronica, and more.
